name: Recap (tap-through fact cards)
use_when: looking back on a trip, a semester or a year as a group: a few big numbers and facts from the chat, one per card
'recap the trip', 'wrapped', 'year in review', 'semester wrapped', 'our stats'
the facts (counts, times, places, amounts) can be read from the chat; nothing has to be decided
dont_use_when: the group has to decide or plan something (use poll, lock or overlap)
a joke, roast, caption or story about someone: Muse does not write banter about people (decline or adapt)
settling money from the trip (use settle)
guarantees: cards show only the facts passed in; the piece writes no captions about people
each person's progress only moves forward; a like flips only that person on that card
the cards never change once posted
a leaver's progress and likes go; a late joiner starts at the first card

title.description: What the recap covers, e.g. 'Nashville trip · Mar 13-16'

label.description: What is counted, sentence case, e.g. 'Steps', 'Latest night'

value.description: The fact itself, 16 characters or fewer, e.g. '61,204', '2:40 AM', '$1,486'

line.description: One plain sentence of fact from the chat, no jokes or opinions, e.g. 'Sam walked 14,310 on Saturday'; or empty

people.description: Names the fact is about, exactly as in the members list; empty if it is about everyone

cards.description: 2 to 8 fact cards, in the order to show them
